summary: TestFlight bug-fix regression PASS (6/6 testable fixes verified). Backend: 4/4 pytest tests green — /_broadcast_new_member writes notifications with ref_user_id, /api/notifications/{uid} exposes the field, /api/flutters/send accepts Say-Hi payload (from_id+to_id only), /api/health 200. Frontend web preview verified after supervisorctl restart expo (CI-mode bundle needed reload): notifications screen now renders 38 Say Hi + 38 View profile buttons on new_member rows; Say Hi triggers a real flutter and shows 'Flutter sent 🦋' toast; admin report page shows underlined tappable 'N other reports on file — view history' (role=link, cursor=pointer, tabindex=0) that navigates to /admin/user/<target_id>; friends-back navigates directly to /home; profile screen loads with name + invites stat visible; coffee lounge table page renders (with seating diagram + composer, no red-screen); AvatarBubble renders both emoji and photo variants across screens. Apple Sign-In (Issue #1) untested — requires real device build. No deprecated Expo packages introduced by this batch.
action_items: Apple Sign-In (Issue #1) remains — needs a real iOS TestFlight build with production env vars to exercise the JWKS + audience verification path. Cannot be validated in this environment.
critical_code_review_comments: notifications.tsx renderItem now branches for isNewMember; overall file remains well within size limits.

table/[id].tsx: keyboard listeners correctly cleaned up in useEffect return; collapseSeating hides seating when kbOpen || text.length > 0 — logic verified by code review (real keyboard behaviour needs iOS device).
profile.tsx useFocusEffect now fires-and-forgets refresh() with a cancelled closure guard — will not block on network, avoids the previous re-render flash.
AvatarBubble: photo mode gains resizeMode='cover' + overflow:'hidden' — combined with borderRadius=size/2 produces a proper circular crop. Emoji fallback path unchanged.
seed_data_creation: One transient real signup created per test run (username testnew_<8-hex>) — used to trigger _broadcast_new_member. Not cleaned up (harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Metro runs with CI=true so file edits require `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` before web preview reflects changes. Admin demo account is maggie (id 7452ce79-7027-4a94-9669-0ee3a521a5ec, is_admin=true). Report id 9053d524-8aef-4c0f-9dac-bfa8ebef6c42 targets a user with 3 sibling reports — good fixture for admin/report/[id] regression.
rca_of_issue: Initial run showed 0 Say Hi buttons even though API returned ref_user_id. Root cause: Metro CI-mode caches the previous bundle; a supervisorctl restart of expo picked up notifications.tsx changes and buttons rendered correctly (38 each) on the next reload.
